TestLwtDestructiveDDL::test_drop_table.description: 3-node cluster (3 racks), 4 LWT threads (INSERT IF NOT EXISTS / UPDATE IF / DELETE IF EXISTS, also as batches) while 4 threads loop DROP TABLE + CREATE TABLE for 60s. Asserts only that all nodes stay live and no unexpected ERRORs in logs (expected: no_such_column_family, mutation write failures, CAS prune failures). Guards against crashes when paxos/prune hits a dropped table.
